listing.title: Traditional Hand-Woven Purulia Bamboo and Cane Utility Basket
listing.description: Hand-woven in the Purulia region of West Bengal, this traditional basket showcases the meticulous skill of rural artisans. Each piece is crafted over a full day by carefully interlacing natural bamboo and cane strips, creating a durable, eco-friendly utility basket that carries the legacy of generations-old basketry techniques.
